title: Grateful Dead Live at Dillon Gym, Princeton University on 1971-04-17
source: flac16/48kHz; SBD Master Reel originally recorded with analog equipment on a 7 inch, 7.5 i.p.s half-track master reel; Transferred to 16 48 WAV February 2017

ai_review.summary: Legendary show with Pigpen in top form on a smoking Good Lovin', captured in an unknown‑source recording of solid quality.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this performance, calling it essential and legendary. They highlight Ron "Pigpen" McKernan’s stellar vocals and harmonica on Good Lovin' and the band’s far‑out psychedelic interplay, while noting no audio flaws despite the unknown source. The energy is described as high‑octane and the show is deemed a must‑listen for any Deadhead.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews emphasize an outstanding performance with no recorded complaints about sound quality, suggesting a strong show and at least decent audio.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not mention any recording issues; the lack of criticism implies acceptable clarity despite unknown source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Specific set details are absent, but reviewers praise the overall flow and psychedelic interplay throughout the performance.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen delivers top‑form vocals, harmonica and an elaborate rap section that reviewers call the most elaborate ever on Good Lovin'.
